QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Izuna's Entourage
QuestInfo.0: Visit Izuna at the Mushroom Shrine and ask her to be your friend.
QuestInfo.1: Izuna is upset with Kurama. You'll need to get on Kurama's good side before he tells you what's going on.
QuestInfo.2: It looks like Izuna is still angry about what Kurama said. Maybe he can make things right?
